evidence.source_title: Spott raises $3.2M to launch first AI-native platform for recruitment firms
evidence.summary: Spott's company resource describes a recruitment-agency platform built as an integrated AI-native ATS/CRM rather than a collection of disconnected point tools.
extracted_facts: Spott says it was founded in November 2024.
The company describes one platform combining ATS, CRM, analytics and AI agents for recruitment firms.
The company says workflows include candidate matching, outreach, interview scheduling, transcript processing, pipeline management, reporting and business-development support.
The company article reports a $3.2 million seed round led by Base10 with participation from Y Combinator, True Equity and Fortino Capital.

evidence.source_title: Leuven-based Spott raises €18.3 million to build the AI-native operating system for recruitment agencies
evidence.summary: Fresh EU-Startups search-result content reports Spott raised €18.3 million ($21 million) in a Series A led by Balderton Capital, with Base10 Partners, Y Combinator and Fortino participating.
extracted_facts: EU-Startups reports a €18.3 million ($21 million) Series A for Spott.
EU-Startups reports Balderton Capital as lead investor and Base10 Partners, Y Combinator and Fortino as participants.
EU-Startups describes Spott as a Leuven-based AI-native ATS and CRM platform for recruitment agencies.

payload.summary: Spott's first-party description positions one AI-native ATS/CRM as the recruitment agency's operating layer, consolidating candidate data, matching, outreach, scheduling, transcript processing, pipeline management, reporting and business development instead of adding a single AI point solution.
